name: GotongHR cache rules
description: Bypass cache for /api, /auth, and HTML requests that carry a Better Auth session cookie. Cache /assets for one year. Rules are first match, so the asset rule is before the cookie bypass.

rules.description: Never cache API or auth responses.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/"))

rules.description: Edge-cache content-hashed Vite assets for one year. Session cookies do not bypass this rule.
Bypass cache for other paths when a Better Auth session cookie is present. Hashed assets are excluded.
